usage: 规则 + 不规则动词。过去具体时间用过去式。
examples: I went home early.
Did she call you?
They didn't watch TV.
mistakes: 过去式与现在完成时混用
否定句/疑问句 did 后没用原形
compare: 过去式 vs. 现在完成时：yesterday vs. ever/never/just。

usage: was/were + V-ing。描述过去某时正在进行的动作。
examples: I was reading when she called.
They were having dinner at 8 p.m.
It was raining all night.
mistakes: was/were 后加原形（*was rain*）
漏掉 was/were
compare: 过去进行时 vs. 一般过去时：背景动作 vs. 打断动作。

usage: have/has + 过去分词。表过去经历与现在有关。
examples: I have visited Paris.
Have you ever been to Japan?
She has never eaten sushi.
mistakes: 与过去时间连用（*I have visited yesterday*）
have 后加过去式而非过去分词
compare: 现在完成时 vs. 一般过去时：无具体过去时间 vs. 有具体过去时间。

usage: just（刚刚）, already（已经）, yet（还）常与现在完成时连用。
examples: I've just finished.
She has already left.
Have you eaten yet?
mistakes: yet 用于肯定句
already 用于疑问句时位置错
compare: already 用于肯定/疑问，yet 用于否定/疑问句末。

usage: for + 一段时间；since + 时间点。常搭配现在完成时。
examples: I have lived here for ten years.
She has worked here since 2020.
We haven't eaten for hours.
mistakes: for 后接时间点
since 后接一段时间
compare: for 是 duration，since 是 starting point。

usage: have been to 表示去过（已回）；have gone to 表示去了（未回）。
examples: He has been to Paris. (回来了)
He has gone to Paris. (还在那儿)
I've been there twice.
mistakes: been 与 gone 混用
been to 漏 to
compare: been 表经历，gone 表不在此地。

grammar: Future: will / going to / present continuous
usage: will 表临时决定/承诺；be going to 表计划/迹象；现在进行时表已安排。
examples: I'll get it. (临时)
I'm going to buy a car. (计划)
I'm meeting her at 6. (已安排)
mistakes: will 与 be going to 完全等同
现在进行时表未来时漏时间状语
compare: will 临时，be going to 计划/迹象，现在进行已安排。

usage: 时间状语从句中用一般现在时表将来。
examples: When I arrive, I'll call you.
I'll tell him as soon as I see him.
After she finishes, we'll go.
mistakes: 时间状语从句中用 will（*When I will arrive*）
主句用一般现在时表将来
compare: 主将从现：主句将来，从句现在。

usage: can/could 能力/请求；may/might 许可/可能（might 更不确定）。
examples: You may leave now.
It might rain tomorrow.
Could you help me?
mistakes: 情态动词后加 to 或 -s
may/might 语气不分
compare: might 比 may 可能性更小。

grammar: Must / have to / should / need to
usage: must 强烈/主观；have to 客观；should 建议；need to 需要。
examples: You must wear a helmet.
I have to leave now.
You should apologize.
mistakes: must 与 have to 完全等同
should 后加 to
compare: mustn't（禁止） vs. don't have to（不必）。

usage: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves。
examples: I did it myself.
She taught herself Spanish.
We enjoyed ourselves.
mistakes: 主语与反身代词不一致（*He did it myself*）
enjoy 后漏反身代词
compare: enjoy yourself, by yourself, teach yourself。

usage: some- 用于肯定；any- 用于否定/疑问；no- 本身否定；every- 表单数。
examples: I have something to tell you.
Did you see anything?
Nothing is impossible.
mistakes: anything 用于肯定句（需特定语境）
everyone 后接复数动词
compare: everyone/everything + 单数动词。

usage: somebody 某人，anybody 任何人，nobody 没人，everybody 每人。
examples: Somebody is at the door.
I didn't see anybody.
Everybody knows that.
mistakes: everybody 后接复数动词
nobody 与 not anybody 混淆
compare: nobody = not anybody；everybody 接单数动词。

usage: 形容词 + -ly → 副词。well, fast, hard 例外。
examples: She sings beautifully.
He runs fast.
They worked hard.
mistakes: good 与 well 混用
形容词当副词用（*He runs quick*）
compare: good 形容词，well 副词；hard 形容词/副词同形。

usage: more/most + 副词，部分副词有 -er/-est。
examples: He runs faster than me.
She speaks more fluently.
Who works the hardest?
mistakes: 副词比较级加 more 又加 -er
最高级前漏 the
compare: fast→faster→fastest；fluently→more fluently→most fluently。

usage: so + 形容词/副词；such + a/an + 形容词 + 名词。
examples: It's so hot.
She is such a kind person.
The movie was so boring.
mistakes: such 后漏 a/an
so + 名词（*so nice weather*，应为 such nice weather）
compare: so + adj/adv；such + a/an + adj + noun。

usage: very 表程度；too 表过度（负面）；enough 表足够（形容词/副词后）。
examples: It's very cold.
It's too expensive for me.
He isn't old enough to drive.
mistakes: enough 放在形容词前
very 与 too 语气不分
compare: too...to 结构表太……而不能。

usage: be good at, be interested in, be afraid of, be worried about。
examples: She is good at math.
I'm interested in music.
He's afraid of dogs.
mistakes: 介词搭配错误（*good in*）
be 动词后接动词原形
compare: 形容词后的介词多为固定搭配，需记忆。

usage: look for, listen to, wait for, talk about, ask for。
examples: I'm looking for my keys.
Listen to me.
She asked for help.
mistakes: 介词漏掉（*look my keys*）
介词搭配错误
compare: 动词短语中介词常改变意义。

usage: put on, take off, turn on, turn off。名词可放中间或后面，代词必须放中间。
examples: Put on your jacket. / Put your jacket on.
Turn it off. (不能 turn off it)
Take off your shoes.
mistakes: 代词放短语动词后（*turn off it*）
名词位置死板
compare: 代词必须放中间：turn it on, pick it up。

usage: look after, run out of, look forward to。宾语不能放中间。
examples: Look after your sister.
We ran out of milk.
I look forward to meeting you.
mistakes: 宾语放中间（*look your sister after*）
look forward to 后接动词原形
compare: look forward to + doing/noun。

usage: 前肯定后否定，前否定后肯定。动词与主句一致。
examples: You're coming, aren't you?
He likes coffee, doesn't he?
She didn't go, did she?
mistakes: 反义疑问句助动词与主句不一致
前否定后也用否定
compare: Let's... 用 shall we?；I'm... 用 aren't I?。

usage: Could you tell me + 陈述语序？Do you know + if/whether？
examples: Could you tell me where the station is?
Do you know if he is coming?
I wonder what happened.
mistakes: 间接疑问句仍用疑问语序（*where is the station*）
if 与 whether 用法完全等同
compare: 间接疑问句用陈述语序。

usage: used to + 动词原形，表过去习惯或状态（现在已不同）。
examples: I used to play football.
She used to be shy.
Did you use to live here?
mistakes: used to 后加 -ing
used to 与 be used to 混淆
compare: used to（过去习惯） vs. be used to（习惯于）+ doing。

grammar: Be used to / get used to
usage: be used to + doing/noun 表习惯；get used to 表逐渐习惯。
examples: I'm used to getting up early.
You'll get used to the noise.
She isn't used to spicy food.
mistakes: be used to 后接动词原形
get used to 与 used to 混用
compare: used to + do（过去）；be used to + doing（习惯）。

usage: would + 动词原形，表过去反复动作。
examples: When I was young, I would play outside.
He would always bring flowers.
We would often go to the beach.
mistakes: would 后加过去式
would 与 used to 完全等同
compare: would 只表动作习惯，used to 可表状态。

usage: If + 一般现在时，will + 动词。表真实可能。
examples: If it rains, I'll stay home.
If you study, you'll pass.
I'll call you if I arrive late.
mistakes: if 从句用 will（*If it will rain*）
主句用一般现在时
compare: 第一条件句：主将从现。

usage: If + 过去式，would + 动词。表虚拟/不太可能。
examples: If I had money, I would buy a car.
If she knew, she would tell us.
If I were you, I'd apologize.
mistakes: if 从句用 would
I were you 写成 I was you（非正式可接受）
compare: 第二条件句：与现在事实相反或不太可能。

usage: wish + 过去式（现在）；wish + had + 过去分词（过去）。
examples: I wish I knew the answer.
If only I had studied harder.
I wish it would stop raining.
mistakes: wish 后接动词原形
wish 与 hope 混用
compare: wish 表遗憾；hope 表真实希望。

usage: who 指人，which 指物，that 可指人或物。
examples: The man who lives here is my uncle.
This is the book which I bought.
I know a place that sells good coffee.
mistakes: which 指人
that 后谓语单复数错误
compare: 限制性定语从句不用逗号隔开。

usage: 介词可放从句末尾或 whom/which 前（正式）。
examples: The man who I spoke to is here.
The house in which I lived is old. (正式)
This is the book I told you about.
mistakes: 介词前置时用 who/that（应为 whom/which）
介词后接 that
compare: 口语中介词常放句末；正式文体放 whom/which 前。

meaning: 限定 vs. 非限定定语从句
usage: 非限定从句用逗号隔开，提供额外信息，不可用 that。
examples: My brother, who lives in London, is a doctor. (非限定)
The car that is parked outside is mine. (限定)
Paris, which is the capital of France, is beautiful.
mistakes: 非限定从句用 that
限定从句逗号错误
compare: 非限定从句中 who/which 不能省略。

usage: 动词 + -ing 作名词用。作主语、宾语、介词宾语。
examples: Swimming is good for you.
I enjoy reading.
She is interested in learning.
mistakes: enjoy 后接 to do
介词后接动词原形
compare: 动名词 vs. 不定式：动名词偏习惯/抽象，不定式偏目的/具体。

usage: to + 动词原形，表目的。
examples: I went to the shop to buy milk.
She studied hard to pass the exam.
He came here to see you.
mistakes: 表目的用 for + 动词原形（*for buy*）
to 后接 -ing
compare: in order to / so as to 更正式。

meaning: 动词 + 动名词/不定式
usage: 有些动词后接 doing（enjoy, finish），有些接 to do（want, decide），有些两者皆可。
examples: I want to leave. (to do)
I enjoy swimming. (doing)
I stopped smoking. (doing) / I stopped to smoke. (to do)
mistakes: stop 后接 to do 与 doing 意义混淆
want 后接 doing
compare: stop doing（停止做） vs. stop to do（停下来去做）。

usage: am/is/are + 过去分词。主语是动作承受者。
examples: The report is written every week.
Coffee is grown in Brazil.
The window is cleaned by him.
mistakes: 被动语态漏掉 be 动词
过去分词用成过去式
compare: 被动语态 vs. 主动语态：主语是动作承受者。

usage: was/were + 过去分词。
examples: The car was repaired yesterday.
The letter was sent this morning.
They were invited to the party.
mistakes: by 后接主语（应为宾语）
was/were 与 did 混用
compare: by + 动作执行者（可省略）。

usage: modal + be + 过去分词。
examples: It can be done.
The work must be finished today.
This should be changed.
mistakes: 情态动词后接过去分词（*can done*）
漏掉 be 动词
compare: modal + be + done。

usage: have/get + 宾语 + 过去分词，表让别人做某事。
examples: I had my hair cut.
We need to get the car repaired.
She got the house painted.
mistakes: have/get 后接动词原形
宾语后接现在分词
compare: have sth done 与 get sth done 同义。

usage: 主句过去时，从句动词通常后退：现在→过去，过去→过去完成。
examples: 'I am tired,' he said. → He said (that) he was tired.
'I saw her,' she said. → She said (that) she had seen her.
'I will call,' he said. → He said (that) he would call.
mistakes: 间接引语仍用直接引语动词形式
that 不能省略（口语可省）
compare: say → said；tell + 宾语。

usage: 疑问句变陈述语序，用 if/whether 或疑问词引导。
examples: 'Are you coming?' she asked. → She asked if I was coming.
'Where is he?' he asked. → He asked where he was.
'Do you like it?' she asked. → She asked whether I liked it.
mistakes: 间接疑问句仍用疑问语序
助动词 do 仍保留
compare: asked + if/whether + 陈述语序。

usage: tell/ask/order + 宾语 + to do/not to do。
examples: 'Close the door,' he said. → He told me to close the door.
'Please help me,' she said. → She asked me to help her.
'Don't be late,' he said. → He told us not to be late.
mistakes: 间接引语保留 please
tell 后接 that + 从句表命令
compare: tell sb to do；ask sb to do；order sb to do。

usage: because 表原因；so 表结果。
examples: I was tired because I worked hard.
I worked hard, so I was tired.
Because it rained, we stayed home.
mistakes: because 与 so 同时用
because 后接句子，because of 后接名词/动名词
compare: because + 句子；because of + noun/gerund。

usage: 表让步，注意不与 but 连用。
examples: Although it rained, we went out.
Though he is young, he is wise.
Even though she was tired, she worked.
mistakes: although 与 but 同时用
though 用于句末时含义不同
compare: although/though 不能与 but 同句；however 可。

usage: 表转折，常放句首或句中，用逗号隔开。
examples: It was raining. However, we went out.
He was tired. Nevertheless, he finished.
mistakes: however 与 but 同句
however 后无逗号
compare: however 是副词，but 是连词。

usage: in case + 句子，表以防万一。
examples: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
I'll call you in case I need help.
In case you forget, here is the key.
mistakes: in case 与 if 混用
in case 后接 will
compare: in case 引导的从句用一般现在时表将来。

usage: unless = if not。除非。
examples: I won't go unless you come too.
Unless you study, you won't pass.
I'll be surprised unless he wins.
mistakes: unless 与 if 双重否定
unless 后接 will
compare: unless 从句用一般现在时表将来。

usage: as soon as/when/until + 一般现在时表将来。
examples: Call me when you arrive.
I'll wait until you come back.
As soon as I finish, I'll call.
mistakes: 时间从句用 will
until 与 by 混用
compare: until 表动作持续到某时；by 表截止时间。

usage: by the time + 现在完成时/过去完成时，表到某时为止。
examples: By the time you arrive, I'll have finished.
By the time he arrived, we had left.
By the time she calls, I'll be ready.
mistakes: by the time 从句用将来时
主句时态错误
compare: by the time 从句用现在时/过去时，主句用完成时。

grammar: Quantity: a few / few / a little / little
meaning: a few / few / a little / little
usage: a few/few + 可数；a little/little + 不可数。a few/a little 表肯定，few/little 表否定。
examples: I have a few friends. (有几个)
I have few friends. (几乎没有)
There's a little milk left. (还有一点)
mistakes: few 与 a few 语气不分
little 与 a little 混用
compare: a few/a little = 一些；few/little = 几乎没有。

usage: all 全部，none 全无，both 两者都，neither 两者都不，either 两者任一。
examples: All of us are here.
Neither answer is correct.
Either day is fine.
mistakes: neither 与 both 混用
either 后接单数还是复数动词
compare: neither/either + 单数动词；both + 复数动词。

usage: each 强调个体，可接 of；every 强调整体，不接 of。
examples: Each student has a book.
Every student has a book.
Each of the students has a book.
mistakes: every 接 of
each 与 every 后接单数动词混淆
compare: each/every + 单数动词。

usage: another + 单数；other + 复数；others 泛指其他人；the others 特定范围内其余。
examples: I need another cup.
Other people may agree.
Some students left, the others stayed.
mistakes: another 后接复数
other 后接单数
compare: another one = 再一个；other = 其他的。

usage: one 代替前文提到的单数可数名词，ones 代替复数。
examples: I prefer the red one.
Your shoes are nicer than mine, but mine are cheaper ones.
I want a big one.
mistakes: one 代替不可数名词
ones 代替单数名词
compare: one/ones 用于避免重复名词。

grammar: So do I / Neither do I
meaning: so do I / neither do I
usage: so + 助动词 + 主语，表示也一样；neither + 助动词 + 主语，表示也不。
examples: I like coffee. So do I.
I don't like tea. Neither do I.
He can swim. So can she.
mistakes: 用 So do I 回应否定句
助动词与上句不一致
compare: so/neither 后接助动词/be/情态动词，再接主语。

usage: also, too, as well, besides, in addition, moreover, furthermore。
examples: I like coffee. I also like tea.
She is smart. Moreover, she works hard.
Besides, it's too expensive.
mistakes: also 位置错误（句末）
too 与 also 位置混淆
compare: also 在句中，too/as well 在句末。

usage: however, on the other hand, in contrast, whereas, while。
examples: He is rich, whereas she is poor.
On the other hand, it might rain.
In contrast, the second option is cheaper.
mistakes: whereas 与 however 完全等同
while 表时间 vs. 对比混淆
compare: while/whereas 可直接连接两个分句。

usage: so, therefore, as a result, consequently, thus。
examples: It rained. Therefore, the match was cancelled.
She was ill. As a result, she stayed home.
He studied hard, so he passed.
mistakes: therefore 与 because 混用
so 与 therefore 同句冗余
compare: therefore 是副词，常放句首或句中。

usage: for example, for instance, such as, like, e.g.
examples: I like fruit, such as apples and oranges.
For example, he always arrives early.
Some countries, like Japan, have high-speed trains.
mistakes: such as 与 for example 后都接完整句子
like 与 as 混用
compare: such as 列举同类事物；for example 可接句子。

usage: 复习不可数名词与量词搭配，以及常见错误。
examples: a piece of advice
a loaf of bread
a bar of chocolate
mistakes: 不可数名词直接加 a/an
量词用错（*a glass of bread*）
compare: 不可数名词需用量词才能计数。

usage: I think (that)..., I believe..., In my opinion..., I agree/disagree。
examples: I think we should leave early.
In my opinion, this is the best option.
I don't agree with you.
mistakes: In my opinion 与 I think 同句冗余
I am agree 错误
compare: I agree（不是 I am agree）；I think + (that) + 从句。

usage: Why don't we...?, How about...?, Let's..., You could..., Maybe we should...
examples: Why don't we go to the cinema?
How about having dinner out?
Maybe we should leave early.
mistakes: How about 后接 to do（应为 doing）
Why don't 后接 I/we 主语不一致
compare: How about/What about + doing/noun。

usage: I agree, That's right, Exactly, I don't think so, I'm not sure about that。
examples: I agree with you.
That's right.
I'm not sure I agree with that.
mistakes: I agree 与 I am agree 混淆
I'm agree 错误
compare: agree 是动词，不是形容词。

usage: Can I speak to...?, I'll put you through, Hold on, I'm afraid he's not here.
examples: Can I speak to John, please?
I'll put you through.
Hold on a moment, please.
mistakes: 电话中说 I want to speak John（漏 to）
Who is calling? 说成 Who are you?（太直接）
compare: This is ... speaking；Who's calling?

usage: 正式邮件用 Dear Sir/Madam, Yours faithfully/sincerely；非正式用 Hi/Hello, Best/Bye。
examples: Dear Mr. Smith, ... Yours sincerely, ...
Hi Tom, ... Best, ...
I am writing to inquire about...
mistakes: 正式邮件结尾用 Love
非正式邮件用 Yours faithfully
compare: I look forward to hearing from you.
